features.statement: Page has no h1; top-level heading is an h2, with card titles as h3 under section h2s.
Quotes are marked up semantically with figure, blockquote and figcaption elements.
Document title is short, brand-plus-season, joined with an em dash rather than SEO keyword listing.
Single neo-grotesque sans-serif typeface (Helvetica Neue) used throughout.
Card and post titles are bold in sentence or title case, while eyebrows, labels and sources are uppercase and tracked.
Small copyright line is sentence case in grey, with a hairline rule above.
Announcement bar is near-black with white text.
Palette mixes near-black text with saturated earthy accent blocks (teal, sage, tan, orange) and warm off-white panels.
Hero is a muted gradient panel with a very large white headline and an outlined button.
Images are replaced by flat or gradient colour blocks, such as 1x1 placeholders stretched to full size.
Feature tiles are edge-to-edge coloured blocks with eyebrow, bold name and underlined link.
Primary calls to action are solid black rectangular buttons, with secondary actions as underlined text links or outlined buttons.
Cards use left-aligned text over a darkening gradient overlay, with top rules on journal cards.
Split sections pair a coloured block with a text column, alternating sides.
Content sits in an inset centred container with generous side margins.
Press quotes appear in a multi-column grid, each with a top rule and uppercase source, followed by dark logo row.
Logo and payment images carry descriptive alt text.
Brand statement gets its own full-width black band with large bold white heading.
Newsletter form joins a dark-bordered input and black submit button in one inline row.
Header has visible uppercase text navigation left and utilities right, around a centred script logo.
Layout relies heavily on CSS grid.
Markup is minimal: few scripts, meta tags, divs, classes, inline styles, forms and ARIA attributes.
All elements have square corners and no shadows; flat design.
Footer shows a row of payment-method badges as small SVG images.
